description: Explain the core concepts of the MLOps lifecycle, maturity models, and the fundamental architectural differences between DevOps, DataOps, and MLOps, including MLOps vs DevOps vs DataOps: Differences and relationships, MLOps maturity models and hierarchy of needs, ML Lifecycle Overview & Deployment Patterns, ML project lifecycle components.

Execute machine learning project scoping, define business key performance indicators (KPIs), select appropriate deployment patterns, and establish reliable performance baselines, including ML Project Scoping & Design, Steps of an ML project: from problem definition to deployment, Defining project milestones and resourcing, Deployment patterns: batch vs online, static vs dynamic inference, Establishing performance baselines and human-level performance (HLP), Scoping a real ML project.

Implement systematic error analysis, data-centric AI techniques, and experiment tracking to address issues like skewed datasets and class imbalance, including Why low average error isn't good enough: prioritizing important examples, Error analysis and performance auditing, Experiment tracking fundamentals, Error analysis on a dataset, Experiment, MLflow for experiment tracking and model registry.

Build automated data pipelines utilizing version control tools (DVC) and centralized feature stores (TFX) to guarantee data lineage and experiment reproducibility, including Data & Model Pipelines, versioning, Enterprise data schemas and data evolution tracking, Data Versioning & Reproducibility, Data Version Control (DVC): implementation and best practices, Git for code versioning + DVC for data versioning.

Design and coordinate end-to-end machine learning orchestration pipelines utilizing components like TensorFlow Extended (TFX) for training, evaluation, and validation, including Model Pipeline & TFX, evaluation, TensorFlow Extended (TFX) pipeline components, Building a TFX pipeline, Evaluation metrics for production.

Apply containerization (Docker) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) workflows to automate model testing and infrastructure provisioning, including Deployment, Monitoring & Operations, CI/CD fundamentals: Continuous Integration vs Continuous Delivery, Automating ML model deployments with CI/CD, Testing and validation in CI/CD pipelines, Containerization & Docker for ML, Docker essentials for ML projects.

Deploy production-grade model serving microservices using architectures like FastAPI, TensorFlow Serving, and Kubernetes supporting progressive delivery patterns, including Model Deployment & Serving, Deployment strategies: batch vs real-time deployment, Model serving patterns, TensorFlow Serving, FastAPI, Progressive delivery techniques, Deploying to different infrastructures, Kubernetes, Kubernetes for scalable model deployment.

Construct automated production monitoring infrastructures with Prometheus, Grafana, and Evidently AI to detect data drift, concept drift, and performance degradation, including Model Monitoring & Drift Detection, Why continuous monitoring is essential, Model monitoring techniques, performance, Model drift vs concept drift: detection and response, Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana.

Architect, document, and present a complete, end-to-end operational MLOps system that solves a real-world enterprise problem, including MLOps Operations & Final Project, Operational excellence of ML systems, Cloud MLOps tools overview.
